7617489.baseName: Habitat 6ft Black Tips Artificial Christmas Tree
7617489.variantName: Habitat 6ft Black Tips Artificial Christmas Tree
7617489.sourceDescription: Make a statement this Christmas with this 6ft artificial tree that brings standout style to your festive setup. The lush branches are tipped with black for a contemporary twist on tradition, giving you a modern look that feels fresh and different. With 497 flat needles spread across hinged branches, it's ready to be fluffed, shaped and dressed exactly how you like it. The sturdy metal stand keeps everything secure while you deck it out with baubles, lights and all your favourite decorations. The hinged branch design means minimal fuss when it comes to assembly, so you can get straight to the fun part. Once the season's over, it folds back down neatly for storage until next year. Made from metal and plastic, it's built for indoor use and gives you a fresh take on festive decor that lets you create a Christmas look that feels uniquely yours. . n9h1se08.baseName: Artemis Home 7ft Silvenholt Pre-Lit PE/PVC Artificial Christmas Tree
n9h1se08.variantName: Artemis Home 7ft Silvenholt Pre-Lit PE/PVC Artificial Christmas Tree
n9h1se08.sourceDescription: Create a welcoming festive centrepiece with the Silvenholt pre-lit artificial Lush Pine, featuring a full pine-style shape and a blend of PE and PVC foliage. Choose the 6ft tree with 1,642 branch tips and 600 LEDs, or the 7ft version with 2,620 tips and 700 LEDs. The foot pedal lets you switch between warm white and multicolour lighting, with steady, twinkling and flashing effects, or alternate between both colours to change the mood of your display. Each size comes with a metal stand and plastic storage bag for packing away once the festivities are over. Adult assembly required. For indoor use only. Artemis Home Ltd. 335A Torquay Road, Paignton, TQ3 2EP

w519dttk.baseName: Christmas Tree World 6ft Pre-Lit Ultra Pop-Up Tree - Warm White Lights
w519dttk.variantName: Christmas Tree World 6ft Pre-Lit Ultra Pop-Up Tree - Warm White Lights
w519dttk.sourceDescription: Looking for a premium pop-up Christmas tree? You just found it! Rather than wasting away the festive period with difficult assembly instructions, this 6ft pre-lit Christmas tree does all the hard work for you. Simply 'pop up' and tweak your branch tips to how you like them! With more pre-attached Christmas lights than our original Pop-Up Christmas tree and a realistic mix of PE & PVC branch tips, we're sure you're going to love this stunning yet affordable 6ft Christmas tree. Plus, these 6ft slim Christmas trees are as easy to take down as they are to assemble - ideal for anyone with limited space and limited time. Picture shows 7ft tree in the range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 6ft • Pre-lit with 200 professionally strung warm white static LEDS • Number of branch tips: 686 PE/PVC branch tips on suspended garland • Tree width: 60cm diameter • Foliage colour: Two-tone "New-shoot" green • Space saving: Unique pop-up design • Easy assembly: Garland suspends around centrepole • Sturdy base: Metal stand • Fire resistant: Fire retardancy certified • Indoor use only: The trees construction will rust in rain • Height measured from the floor • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

2y5x1tgj.baseName: Walplus 300 Warm LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 180 cm
2y5x1tgj.variantName: Walplus 300 Warm LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 180 cm
2y5x1tgj.sourceDescription: This Modern Artificial Christmas Tree combines sleek contemporary style with festive cheer, perfect for enhancing seasonal décor. Designed with a cone shape, it's crafted from PVC material and features warm LED lights. Its simplicity and functionality make it an ideal choice for those seeking a stylish touch during holiday festivities, whether in living rooms or outdoor terraces. Sturdy Materials Made with durable PVC and steel, offering reliability and stability for holiday decorations. LED Strip Lights Flexible lighting strips provide a warm, inviting glow, enhancing festive mood and atmosphere. USB Compatibility Utilizes a USB power source, making it easy to integrate with existing electronic setups. Indoor &Outdoor Use Suitable for versatile decoration, adapting to different environments inside and out. Care Instructions Protect the tree with a cover when not in use to maintain its pristine condition. Product Specifications Colour: Green PVC and plastic and steel Tree height: 180 cm Bottom diameter: 99 cm Stand size: 45 x 45 cm Decorated with pine corns and red berries Lifelike Tips Hinged Branches for Easy Setup Snow Flocked Number of PVC tips: 757 Number of pine cones: 30 Number of red berries: 28 Number of baubles: 120 Lights type: LED strip lights Lights color: Warm white Lights length: 300 cm Number of LEDs: 300 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Wattage: 5 W Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Artificial Christmas tree 1 x Foldable stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 40 x 3 cm ball 40 x 4 cm ball 40 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
